modules.name: clear_tall_tree
modules.description: Clears a whole tree (logs and leaves) including parts too high to reach: finds the nearest tree of the target's species, breaks what it can from the ground, picks up the dropped logs, gathers more pillar material (dirt) if needed, pillars up in the trunk column breaking every log/leaf in reach, then digs its own pillar back down to the ground (no fall damage, no scaffolding left).

origin.goal: g-1: break the tree closest to you, leaves included. The leaves won't decay on their own

modules.name: craft_wooden_pickaxe
modules.description: Crafts a wooden pickaxe: chops nearby tree logs if the inventory lacks wood, turns logs into planks, makes sticks, finds or places a crafting table next to the bot (crafting one if needed), and crafts the pickaxe at it.

origin.goal: g-1: make a wooden pickaxe and put it in the chest

modules.name: deposit_wooden_pickaxe_in_chest
modules.description: Walks to the nearest container of the target block type (e.g. chest), opens it, deposits every wooden_pickaxe from the inventory (nothing else), and closes it. Does not place a new container.

origin.goal: g-1: make a wooden pickaxe and put it in the chest

modules.name: pickaxe_deposited
modules.description: No wooden_pickaxe in inventory and bot within 4 blocks of a seen chest
modules.code: (s) => { const c = (s.blocks["chest"]||[]); return !(s.inventory["wooden_pickaxe"]>0) && c.length>0 && dist(s.self.pos, c[0]) <= 4; }

origin.goal: g-3: put the wooden pickaxe in the chest

modules.name: hostile_near_josh_or_bot
modules.description: A hostile mob is within 10 blocks of Josh or of the bot
modules.code: (s) => { const H = ['zombie','zombie_villager','husk','drowned','skeleton','stray','wither_skeleton','spider','cave_spider','creeper','witch','pillager','vindicator','evoker','ravager','vex','slime','magma_cube','phantom','silverfish','endermite','blaze','ghast','hoglin','zoglin','piglin_brute','guardian','elder_guardian','warden','bogged','breeze']; const josh = s.entities.find(e => e.username === 'Josh'); for (const e of s.entities) { if (e.type === 'player') continue; if (!(e.type === 'hostile' || H.includes(e.name))) continue; if (dist(e.pos, s.self.pos) <= 10) return true; if (josh && dist(e.pos, josh.pos) <= 10) return true; } return false; }

origin.goal: g-1: follow me and keep me safe

modules.name: tree_cleared_52_6
modules.description: No log/leaves seen within 2 of [52,-60,-6] (column up to +10), bot within 6
modules.code: (s) => { const p=[52,-60,-6]; if (dist(s.self.pos,p)>6) return false; for (const k of Object.keys(s.blocks)) { if (!(k.endsWith('_log')||k.endsWith('_leaves'))) continue; for (const b of s.blocks[k]) { if (Math.abs(b[0]-p[0])<=2 && Math.abs(b[2]-p[2])<=2 && b[1]>=p[1]-1 && b[1]<=p[1]+10) return false; } } for (const k of s.crowded) if (k.endsWith('_log')||k.endsWith('_leaves')) return false; return true; }

origin.goal: g-1: break the tree closest to you, leaves included. The leaves won't decay on their own

modules.name: craft_and_deposit_wooden_shovel
modules.description: Crafts exactly one wooden shovel (chops nearby logs if wood is short, makes planks, one batch of sticks, finds or places a crafting table) and then walks to the nearest container of the target block type, opens it, deposits only the wooden_shovel, and closes it. Does not place a new container.

origin.goal: g-1: make a wooden shovel and put it in the chest

modules.name: shovel_deposited
modules.description: Wooden shovel crafted and put away: none in inventory, leftover sticks from crafting (count 2 mod 4), and bot within 4 blocks of a seen chest
modules.code: (s) => { const inv = s.inventory || {}; const st = inv.stick || 0; if ((inv.wooden_shovel || 0) > 0) return false; if (st % 4 !== 2) return false; const c = (s.blocks && s.blocks.chest) || []; return c.some(p => dist(p, s.self.pos) <= 4); }

origin.goal: g-1: make a wooden shovel and put it in the chest
